question: Who publishes the Global Terrorism Index 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Institute for Economics and Peace**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The **Global Terrorism Index (GTI)** is published annually by the **Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP)**, a global think tank headquartered in **Sydney, Australia**.

• The index provides a **comprehensive summary of global trends in terrorism**, analyzing its impact across countries and regions.

• The GTI measures terrorism using various indicators such as **number of incidents, fatalities, injuries, and property damage**.

• It is based on data collected by the **Global Terrorism Database (GTD)**, maintained by the University of Maryland.

• The report offers insights into **patterns of terrorism**, its causes, and societal impacts, making it a crucial resource for policymakers, academics, and researchers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP):**

• The IEP is an independent, non-partisan think tank established in **2008** with the aim to develop metrics for peace and to promote a better understanding of the drivers of peace.

• The organization is known for publishing global indices such as the **Global Peace Index (GPI)** and the **Global Terrorism Index (GTI)**.

• Its headquarters is located in **Sydney, Australia**, and it has offices in New York, Brussels, and Mexico City.

• IEP works on research related to **peace and conflict studies, economic impact of violence, and strategies to improve societal resilience.**

• **Global Terrorism Database (GTD):**

• The GTD is a comprehensive database on terrorist incidents worldwide, maintained by the **National Consortium for the Study of Terrorism and Responses to Terrorism (START)** at the University of Maryland.

• It includes data on over **200,000 terrorist events** from 1970 to the present.

• The database is widely used by researchers, policymakers, and institutions for analyzing terrorism trends and impacts.

• **Key Features of the Global Terrorism Index:**

• It categorizes countries based on their levels of terrorist activity, ranging from **the most affected to least affected.**

• The index highlights regions most vulnerable to terrorism and identifies trends in **terrorist tactics, motives, and organizational behavior.**

• It also explores **underlying factors** contributing to terrorism, such as political instability, socioeconomic factors, and conflicts.

• **Uses of the Global Terrorism Index:**

• Policymakers use the index to formulate **counter-terrorism strategies** and allocate resources effectively.

• Academics and researchers employ GTI data for studies on **global security, peacebuilding, and conflict resolution.**

• The index also informs international organizations, such as the **United Nations**, for crafting global initiatives to combat terrorism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **SIPRI:** The Stockholm International Peace Research Institute focuses on research related to **conflicts, armaments, and disarmament**, but does not publish the Global Terrorism Index.

• **United Nations:** While the UN addresses global terrorism issues, it does not release a specific index such as the GTI.

• **WHO:** The World Health Organization is primarily concerned with global health issues and does not engage in terrorism-related studies.
